fusions.name: Snaring Tuft
fusions.desc: Flings a snarl of strands that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Shed Fur
fusions.desc: Looses 5 strands at once, spread apart, each dealing 2 damage, with a 25% chance per hit to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Its damage rises +8% per ally within 5 tiles (max +32%).

fusions.name: Grooming Circle
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions from you and every ally within 5 tiles, and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Matted Pelt
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (21% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
